blocks.orig: Mahale Mountains national park is located in western Tanzania. It is south of the city of Kigoma, and got its name from the Mahale Mountains. These mountains are one of only two protected areas for chimpanzees in Tanzania and the chimpanzee population is the largest known. It is the only place where chimpanzees and lions co-exist. Mahale Mountains national park sits among the spectacular, forested mountain slopes. The protection of the thousands of chimpanzees that inhabit the region was originally and main reason to create the park.
blocks.html: In western Tanzania, south of the city of Kigoma, lies Mahale Mountains national park, which takes its name from the Mahale Mountains. These mountains form one of just two protected areas for chimpanzees in Tanzania, and their chimpanzee population is the biggest known. Nowhere else do chimpanzees and lions live side by side. The park is set among striking, forest-covered mountain slopes. It was first created, and mainly so, to protect the thousands of chimpanzees living in the area.

blocks.orig: The park (like its northerly neighbor Gombe) is home to some of the Africa’s last remaining wild chimpanzees, a population of roughly 900, they are habituated to human visitors. As the chimpanzees are susceptible to many human diseases, strict rules apply to the safe conduct of primate safaris in Tanzania. Don’t miss out on this adventure! And spend time during your hike through the Mahale mountains national park searching for the chimpanzees. The hikes are led by knowledgeable and experienced guides. You will meet the resident chimpanzee group and have time to observe them. Meeting the chimpanzees is a once in a lifetime, magical experience!
blocks.html: Like Gombe, its neighbour to the north, the park shelters some of Africa’s last wild chimpanzees: around 900 of them, all used to human visitors. Because chimpanzees can catch many human diseases, primate safaris in Tanzania follow strict rules to keep them safe. Don’t let this adventure pass you by! Take the time on your hike through Mahale Mountains national park to look for the chimpanzees. Experienced, knowledgeable guides lead the hikes, and you will meet the resident chimpanzee group and get time to watch them. Coming face to face with the chimpanzees is a magical, once in a lifetime experience!

blocks.orig: Mahale Mountains national park is also famous for its fantastic sunsets over Lake Tanganyika, which makes it an essential stop for keen photographers and safari enthusiasts. Another unusual feature of the park is that it is one of the few in Africa where you will be walking, as there are no roads within the park boundaries. The only way in and out of the park is by boat across the lake.
blocks.html: The park is also known for its wonderful sunsets over Lake Tanganyika, making it a must for safari lovers and keen photographers. Another unusual thing about Mahale Mountains national park is that it is one of only a few parks in Africa that you explore on foot, because there are no roads inside its boundaries. You can only get in and out by boat across the lake.

blocks.orig: The park’s breathtaking array of habitats include rainforest, grasslands, alpine bamboo and woodlands. You can find over 50 species of animals here. Predominant among these being representatives from various monkey and ape families. And over 100 unique species of fish swim in the clear waters of the lake.
blocks.html: The park has a stunning range of habitats, from grasslands and rainforest to woodlands and alpine bamboo. More than 50 animal species live here, most of them members of various ape and monkey families. In the lake’s clear waters, there are also over 100 unique fish species.

blocks.orig: Travel time to Mahale Mountains National park
blocks.html: How long it takes to reach Mahale Mountains National park

blocks.orig: By flight (to Kigoma) is the easiest way to reach Mahale. From Kigoma it takes a 7 hours drive. There is also an airstrip at Mahale, but it is not easy to get a connection to Mahale Airstrip. We will of course give you an advice of how to reach Mahale on the most comfortable way and on the cheapest way. You can compare and decide yourself what feels best to you.
blocks.html: Flying to Kigoma is the simplest way to get to Mahale, followed by a 7 hours drive from Kigoma. Mahale also has an airstrip, though connections to Mahale Airstrip are hard to come by. We will naturally advise you on both the most comfortable and the cheapest way to reach Mahale, so you can weigh them up and choose what suits you best.

blocks.orig: Best time to visit Mahale Mountains National Park
blocks.html: When to visit Mahale Mountains National Park

blocks.orig: Mahale Mountains National Park can be visited throughout the year. The best time to visit is in the long dry season from July to October. During this period, chimpanzees are likely to be seen in big groups, the sunshine illuminates the fish in the Lake and the beach is an inviting place to relax.
blocks.html: You can visit Mahale Mountains National Park all year round, but the best time is the long dry season from July to October. In these months you are likely to see chimpanzees in large groups, the sun lights up the fish in the Lake and the beach is a lovely spot to relax.

blocks.orig: Mahale Mountains National Park is located in western Tanzania and has one of only two protected areas for chimpanzees in Tanzania. The chimpanzee population in Mahale Mountain National Park is the largest known and the only place where chimpanzees and lions co-exist.
blocks.html: Located in western Tanzania, Mahale Mountains National Park contains one of just two protected areas for chimpanzees in the country. Its chimpanzee population is the biggest known, and it is the only place where lions and chimpanzees live side by side.
